body:
Found live: test_emit_llvm (and pre-existing test_emit_ts/test_emit_java) were only ever compile-checked by bazel build //..., never actually run. New bazel test //tests:test_emit_llvm --test_output=all CI step, verified locally (35/35 passing). Named the same pre-existing gap for test_emit_ts/test_emit_java honestly, not touched.

⚓ ☃
title: Real CI coverage for test_emit_llvm added
